name: race_cap_20_minutes
description: The hard cap (design 1.3, contract-m6 4: cap_t 72000, honoured now): a race neither team has finished ends when the match reaches 20 minutes, 72000 ticks, and not a tick before. At the cap the waves cleared decide, then the lives, then (where both have one) the race time; all equal is a draw. Here both teams' windows are held open by countdown writes. High Water has no cap: it plays on.

steps.msg: Tide Race's cap is 20 minutes; High Water has none

steps.assert: not m.over and m.decided_by() == '' and m.tick == 71999
steps.msg: a tick before 20 minutes, the race goes on

steps.assert: m.over and m.tick == 72000 and m.decided_by() == 'cap' and m.outcomes() == [0, 1]
steps.msg: at 20 minutes it is over: team A cleared three waves to team B's two
as many waves: the more lives win
as many waves and lives, no race times: a draw
High Water plays on past 20 minutes
